description: A configured companion persona remains consistent across a multi-turn conversation.
invariants: tone changes do not rewrite factual identity

description: Switching OpenAI-compatible providers must not silently replace the user's selected companion identity.
invariants: provider metadata never becomes persona memory

description: Conflicting or inferred memories require explicit provenance and must not overwrite verified facts silently.
invariants: unverified inference is not stored as fact

description: Conversation mode may reason and answer but cannot execute workspace tools without an explicit mode change.
invariants: blocked execution is visible in audit evidence

description: Secrets and sensitive personal data are never automatically persisted as memory.
invariants: sensitive writes require explicit informed consent

description: Voice and text inputs share one normalized conversation message protocol.
invariants: normalized role and content semantics match
